newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes up a cent to 14.99 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes up a cent to 14.99 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended a cent higher at 14.99 ringgit ($5.99) a kg, in a slight response to a strong overnight on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"There were some keen buyers but quite a number of sellers too," said a trader. "The price would have gone beyond 15 (ringgit) if some buyers did not withdraw at the higher level."

Traders noted initial bids of 89 tonnes against offers of 78. Turnover was 83 tonnes against 69 on Wednesday. There was a discount of $10 against London, compared to the previous $15 premium - Barani Krishnaan (603-2307509) ($1= 2.5230 ringgit).
